translatorChecks.reviewerNotes: Preserved all paragraph boundaries, bracket and brace lacunae, repetitions, ellipses, quoted singing, canonical stage directions, and the deliberately malformed bracket/parenthesis sequences near the end. The source phrase literally reading My home was Rav Shlomo appears to omit the preposition at; the contextual reading at Rav Shlomo’s is supported by the legacy witness. There was no beard remains contextually ambiguous and was not conjecturally repaired. The unusual niqqud/spacing in the sung Na Nach phrase was rendered in the established English form.

qa.reviewNotes: Clause-by-clause review found the translation complete and source-faithful. All 58 source paragraphs are preserved, including every bracket/brace/parenthesis mismatch, lacuna and ellipsis, repeated interviewer turns, embedded song line and newline, stage directions present in the source, and the final malformed bracketed transcription; no unsupported stage direction or addition was found.
